title: Values — WhiteHouse College of Business & Technology
description: WhiteHouse College of Business & Technology — Kathmandu University affiliated BIT and B.Tech Ed IT programs in Jhapa, Nepal.

paras: Integrity, excellence, innovation, inclusiveness, and leadership shape how WCBT teaches, supports students, and grows as an institution.
Premises of Nidi Secondary School & Indreni Campus

blocks.heading: How our values show up on campus
paras: These values guide academic delivery, student services, partnerships, and campus culture.

groups.title: Integrity
text: We promote honesty, responsibility, and ethical decision-making in academic and institutional life.

groups.title: Excellence
text: We set high expectations for teaching, learning, service, and student outcomes.

groups.title: Innovation
text: We encourage practical problem-solving, experimentation, and technology-enabled learning.

groups.title: Inclusiveness
text: We support students from diverse backgrounds through guidance, access, and care.

groups.title: Leadership
text: We prepare students to take initiative, collaborate, and contribute with confidence.

blocks.heading: Experience our student-centered culture
paras: Visit the campus or contact our team to learn how WCBT supports students.
